question: Show the date of the transcript which shows the least number of results, also list the id.
gold_query: SELECT Transcripts.transcript_date , Transcripts.transcript_time , Transcript_Contents.transcript_id FROM Transcript_Contents JOIN Transcripts ON Transcript_Contents.transcript_id = Transcripts.transcript_id GROUP BY Transcript_Contents.transcript_id ORDER BY count(*) asc LIMIT 1
